body: Closes REDGARDEN_GUI_NORTHSTAR.md's own named gap: 'No GUI login path exists yet end-to-end (a player still has to run REDGARDEN's client by hand with the printed command).' Same 'mint for the caller's own JWT subject' trust model as ShankpitTicketHandler -- deliberately a separate endpoint from RedgardenPlayerTicketHandler (mints on behalf of a request-body player_id, restricted to the DRAGONSNSHIT-MUD agent) so that handler's own blast-radius guarantee (can never impersonate a real human) stays untouched. REDGARDEN's apps/arena client calls /api/v1/auth/email/login for a player JWT, then this endpoint with that JWT directly. 404 if the authenticated player has no registered DragonsNShit character. 6 new tests, full suite green. Verified live end-to-end via curl (register/login/self-ticket, both success and 404-no-character paths) before wiring the C client; test player cleaned up afterward. Commit 5cd0fd0, changelog be2e4a1.
title: POST /api/v1/redgarden/self-ticket -- real GUI login path for REDGARDEN
